definition: N^p H^{2p}(X,Q)=sum/union over closed Z with codim_X Z>=p of ker[H^{2p}(X,Q)->H^{2p}(X-Z,Q)]
ordinary_hodge_equivalent_statement: At degree 2p only: H^{2p}(X,Q)∩H^{p,p} subset N^p H^{2p}(X,Q) is equivalent to rational algebraicity.
proof_steps: For smooth codimension-p support component W, purity/Gysin identifies the degree-2p support generator H^0(W,Q)(-p) with the fundamental class [W].

For singular W, stratify or resolve; lower-dimensional singular strata contribute in higher support degree, while the degree-2p top contribution is the fundamental class of each codimension-p irreducible component.
Components of codimension >p have no degree-2p top support contribution.
Thus every degree-2p supported class is a rational linear combination of codimension-p fundamental classes; conversely every such cycle class restricts to zero off its support.
scope: smooth projective complex variety X; rational coefficients; degree n=2p
singular_support_typing: Use resolution/stratification plus top Borel-Moore homology; no smoothness of the support itself is assumed.
theorem: N^p H^{2p}(X,Q) equals the Q-span of codimension-p algebraic cycle classes
